description: Builds SwiftUI views with modern MV architecture, state management, navigation, sheets, deep links, previews, theming, controls, and view composition patterns. Covers @Observable ownership rules, @State/@Bindable/@Environment wiring, view decomposition, custom ViewModifiers, environment values, async data loading with .task, iOS 26+ APIs, Writing Tools, and performance guidelines. Use when structuring a SwiftUI app, managing state with @Observable, composing view hierarchies, or applying SwiftUI best practices.
